A '''Starting Effect''' is an [[Effect]] deployed before the game's starting cards are revealed, with a stack of cards from outside the deck under it. Starting Effects appear in the [[Players Committee]]'s [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Original Virtual sets]] (2003–2008). The banner on the slip reads STARTING EFFECT instead of EFFECT; the printed [[Decipher]] card under the slip is an ordinary Effect.

== How it works ==
The 2003 release text of [[Ineffective Maneuver (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Ineffective Maneuver (V)]] and [[Sudden Impact (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Sudden Impact (V)]] reads:

"Before any starting cards are revealed, deploy on table with up to 5 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Cards under here do not count toward your deck limit. Thrice per game, may lose 2 Force to play a Defensive Shield from here, as if from hand."<ref name="vs5-2003">VirtualCards5.pdf, the Players Committee's Virtual Set #5 release sheet (PDF dated 12 June 2003), slips 10 and 47.</ref> The December 2006 Remaster sheet shortens this to "Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face-down under here. Three times per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand)."<ref name="vs5-2006">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf VirtualCards5.pdf] (swccgpc.com, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — Remaster sheet, official text as of 4 December 2006.</ref>

A Starting Effect gives a deck a side pile of [[Defensive Shield]]s that can be played during the game without being part of the deck. On the later cards the pile can also hold a few named Effects. Because it is still an Effect, it can be targeted as one unless its text says otherwise. The later Starting Effects of [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]] and [[Virtual Set 15: Galactic Frontier]] also tax repeated searches that take cards into hand or deploy from Reserve Deck.
